zh: 西澳大学（，简称：UWA）1911年创校，澳洲著名高等学府，位于澳大利亚联邦西澳大利亚州的首府珀斯，同时也是西澳第一所大学，加上特殊的沙岩建筑和壮观的植物园，在澳洲被归为6所砂岩学府（Sandstone universities）之一.
西澳大学自创校以来，一直是澳洲具历史和代表性的研究型学府之一，在众多权威的大学排名中均在世界前100名. 同时也是澳大利亚最享有盛誉的澳洲八大名校（Group of Eight）联盟成员之一. 它在各个领域中对西澳和国家发展与繁荣皆有贡献. 大学培养出澳洲总理鲍勃·霍克，五位最高法院法官，七位西澳州长及一位诺贝尔奖得主.
2008年学生总数有17,436人，研究生人数达4,199. 西澳大学早期位于珀斯的商业中心区，1930年代迁往现时南区卞罗尼（Crawley）的校址. 罗马风格的建筑坐落在花园般的校园内，西澳大学被誉为澳洲最美校园之一. 其共设有三大校区，九大学院.
在2020年US News世界大学排行榜中，西澳大学被列为全球排名第86名. 而在2025年QS世界大学排名中，西澳大学位列第77名.
在2020年QS世界大学专业排名中 ，西澳大学采矿工程全球位列第3位，海洋科学位列世界第29位，土木与结构工程位列世界第30位. 另外如化学工程、会计与金融、生物科学、医学、法律、电机工程等专业也均进入世界100强.
en: The University of Western Australia (UWA) is a public research university in Crawley, Western Australia, Australia. UWA was established in 1911 by an act of the Parliament of Western Australia.
The university is classed as one of the "sandstone universities", an informal designation given to the oldest university in each state. It is a member of the Group of Eight.

The university was established in 1911 following the tabling of proposals by a royal commission in September 1910. The original campus, which received its first students in March 1913, was on Irwin Street in the centre of Perth, and consisted of several buildings between Hay Street and St Georges Terrace. Irwin Street was also known as Tin Pan Alley, as many buildings had corrugated iron roofs. These buildings served as the university campus until 1932, when the campus relocated to its present-day site in Crawley.

The founding chancellor, John Winthrop Hackett, died in 1916, and bequeathed property which, after being carefully managed for ten years, yielded £A425,000, equivalent to A$million in, to the university, a far larger sum than expected. This allowed the construction of the main buildings. Many university buildings and landmarks bear his name, including Winthrop Hall and Hackett Hall. In addition, his bequest funded many scholarships, because he did not wish eager students to be deterred from studying because they could not afford to do so.

During UWA's first decade there was controversy about whether the policy of free education was compatible with high expenditure on professorial chairs and faculties. An "old student" publicised his concern in 1921 that there were 13 faculties serving only 280 students.
